test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Mohan started travelling and he first went in the South direction. Then he took a turn to his left and walked a distance. Thereafter, he turned to his right and travelled some distance. Now if he turned to his left and walked again for a certain distance, in which direction is Mohan travelling now? (All turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
According to given conditions,

 
• Mohan started travelling and he first went in the South direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23fc8fa0bef7f2a1324f1172e31a425aafb8ca8d2629827f74b883cee8da34d1.png] 

 
• Then he took a turn to his left and walked a distance. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bbbaa43dfdff0e1a6dcc294a7563bd977153810720166f5c7d02b34e4c00b1c.png] 

 
• Thereafter, he turned to his right and travelled some distance. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a81a74b263343b0a3c6c72e1be6b58618ca2154be93148204bcb8b0a79bb107.png] 

 
• Now if he turned to his left and walked again for a certain distance

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/003c66a970f68385af48fbd7396de0c2252ff314efe450365606123b43f483a3.png] 

Clearly, Mohan is travelling in East direction now.

Hence, '**East**' is the correct answer.
